title: Onboarding Risk Scenarios and Service Contract Matrix
author: Aisha Patel
content:
Purpose

This page catalogs prioritized onboarding risk scenarios for enterprise customers, maps each scenario to the supporting contractual commitments (SLA tier, remediation windows, credits), and provides step-by-step simulation and test scripts teams should run during the onboarding phase. The document is intended for Customer Success (CS), Solutions Engineering, SRE, and Legal when negotiating operational terms.

Scope and audience

- Scope: Enterprise onboarding (provisioning of Dedicated or Private deployments and first 90 days after cutover).
- Audience: CS, Solutions Engineering, SRE, Account Management, Legal.

Quick summary of intent

- Standardize which failure modes we simulate during onboarding and who owns remediation.
- Ensure contractual language maps cleanly to operational playbooks (SLO -> test -> remediation -> credit calculation).
- Provide reproducible test scripts and acceptance criteria so cutovers are repeatable and auditable.

Executive risk matrix (high-level)

| Risk category | Impact to customer | Likely root causes | Primary owner | Escalation path |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Provisioning failure (tenant never provisioned) | High - prevents go-live | IAM misconfig, cloud quotas, terraform drift | Solutions Eng | CS -> Infra SRE -> Eng Platform -> Legal (if contract delay) |
| Capacity surge (unexpected traffic growth) | High - latency/SLO breaches | Under-provisioning, misconfigured autoscale policy | SRE | CS -> SRE -> Product Ops |
| Model degradation / accuracy regression | High - incorrect outputs | Model version mismatch, data drift, prompt change | CS & Applied ML | CS -> Applied ML -> Model Onboarding |
| Network isolation / peering failure (Private) | High - customer unable to route | Firewall rules, VPC peering misconfig | Eng Private Deployments | CS -> Eng Private -> Networking |
| KV cache inconsistency / data staleness | Medium - decreased perf / cost | Cache invalidation bug, TTL misconfig | Eng Serving Runtime | CS -> Serving Runtime -> SRE |
| Billing / quota misattribution | Medium - unexpected charges | Metering bug, attribution config | Finance & Billing | CS -> Finance -> Billing Eng |
| Security gate delay (audit/compliance) | High - regulatory hold | Missing evidence, KMS/HSM integration issues | Security & Compliance | CS -> Security -> Legal |

Risk-to-contract matrix (operational clauses)

Below is a standard mapping we use when reviewing contract language during onboarding. Use this table to validate a customer's Master Services Agreement (MSA) or SOW.

| Risk scenario | Minimum SLA tier offered | Expected SLOs / windows | Standard remediation window | Credit / Remedy | Required acceptance tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Provisioning failure | Enterprise | Provision within 8 business hours for Dedicated; 5 business days for Private on-prem installer | 24 hours initial response, 72 hours remediation plan | Service credit: 10% monthly for >72h outage | Runbook: full terraform apply dry-run; API health probe; audit of resource creation records |
| Capacity surge causing sustained 95th p99 latency breaches | Priority | 95th percentile latency < 200ms for typical gen calls; availability > 99.5% | 1 hour mitigation window, 24h root cause | Auto-scaling burst allowance; credit based on duration beyond mitigation window | Load test at 2x anticipated peak, validate autoscale triggers, fallbacks to cheaper model variant |
| Model quality regression after model upgrade | Enterprise | Quality regression tolerance defined in SOW (e.g., <3% metric drop for primary eval set) | Rollback within 2 hours to previous variant | Remediation: rollback + model QA; credit if unremediated >24h | Canary eval set run (example scripts below); automated acceptance criteria pass |
| Network peering failure (Private) | Enterprise | Connectivity established and verified during cutover | 4 hours to identify, 48 hours to remediate peering in specialist cases | On a case-by-case basis; telepresence and scheduled maintenance windows documented | Packet path test, traceroutes, private endpoint handshake confirmation
